pokedexEntries.bk: They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.

pokedexEntries.wh: It can expand the focus of its eyes, enabling it to see objects in the far distance as if it were using binoculars.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: Very violent Pokémon, they try to clamp down on anything that moves in front of their eyes.

pokedexEntries.as: They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.

pokedexEntries.su: Its unique faculty of sight can detect small prey more than 30 miles away, even in the midst of a sandstorm.

pokedexEntries.mo: After clamping down with its powerful jaws, it twists its body around to rip its prey in half.

pokedexEntries.us: When it spots prey, even at a distance of over 30 miles, it swims through the desert as if it were water, then jumps out and chomps them.

pokedexEntries.um: It conceals itself in sandstorms that Flygon whip up and waits patiently for prey to appear.

pokedexEntries.sw: This Pokémon is known as the Bully of the Sands. Krookodile’s mighty jaws can bite through heavy plates of iron with almost no effort at all.

pokedexEntries.sh: While terribly aggressive, Krookodile also has the patience to stay hidden under sand for days, lying in wait for prey.

pokedexEntries.sc: After clamping down with its powerful jaws, it twists its body around to rip its prey in half.

pokedexEntries.vi: Its unique faculty of sight can detect small prey more than 30 miles away, even in the midst of a sandstorm.

pokedexEntries.za: They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can tear apart the body of an automobile.
